title: Rudder Pedals
sources: Companion Hardware Callout Rev2, supplied Companion+Hardware+Customer+-+Sheet1-2.pdf p1 HK-RS4
2018_Beartracks.pdf, PDF pp19-21 / Q3 pp3-5, Kevin Deutscher: Rigging a Bearhawk, Part 1
Factory AD-002, 4/1/2025, Brake Master Cylinders, pp1-4

issues.issue: Final pedal position and firewall clearance depend on fitted cylinders.
issues.source: Plan 29 / legacy pp19–20; no aircraft-specific fit check.
issues.check: Dry-fit all four cylinders and check full travel before final positioning. Keep hoses and return springs clear of the complete pedal sweep; check required Matco restrictors (AD-002 / GEAR004).

before_build: Before fitting brake pedals, identify the master cylinders and check factory AD-002. Replacement Matco cylinders require travel restrictors on the Companion. See GEAR004.
